date.as_written: samvat 964 miti caitra śuklayā pūrṇṇamāsyāṃ tithau hastānakṣatra, vyāghātayoga, buddhavāra

purpose: Merit transfer in the name of deceased parents Dhanavīrasiṃha and Gaṅgālakṣmī (piOtā dhanavīrasiṃ, mātṛ gaṃgālakṣmiO nihmaṃ, devaṃgata juyāo, nihmasayā nāmana)
notes: The manuscript was copied at Bakaṃ Bāhāra in Lalitapur (Patan) on behalf of Naravīrasiṃha and his family.
